# LegionS

> Merged machine reference repo for the Lenovo Legion Go S (Z2 Go) handheld (Bazzite), consolidating ROG Ally repos, proxmox host audit snapshot, and the Add-Non-Steam-Games-Linux tool.

## Start here
- [README.md](README.md): machine reference + layout table
- [OVERVIEW.md](OVERVIEW.md): single narrative entry point (merged, human-readable)
- [INDEX.md](INDEX.md): full file/directory catalog
- [TASKS.md](TASKS.md): consolidated task backlog index
- [MANIFEST.json](MANIFEST.json): machine-readable file manifest (paths, sizes, sha256)
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): agent working notes, gates, known gaps

## Architecture & state
- [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md): machines, Tailscale IPs, Steam paths
- [state/CURRENT.md](state/CURRENT.md): most recent verified machine status
- [migration/LEGION-GO-S.md](migration/LEGION-GO-S.md): migration runbook
- [migration/DRIVE_EXPANSION.md](migration/DRIVE_EXPANSION.md): 4TB drive expansion log
- [ROG_DRIVE.md](ROG_DRIVE.md): old ROG drive data reference

## Gamepack (Go)
- [gamepack/README.md](gamepack/README.md): archiver/restorer usage
- [gamepack/Makefile](gamepack/Makefile): build/test/coverage/lint/deploy

## Tooling
- [tools/Add-Non-Steam-Games-Linux/README.md](tools/Add-Non-Steam-Games-Linux/README.md): non-Steam game adder
- [tools/README.md](tools/README.md): tools index
